name: Library Shelf Arrangement Puzzle
task:
Please complete the following four-stage logic puzzle task in order.

=== Stage 1: Direct Fact Extraction ===
A library has seven books on a single shelf. Each book has a different color cover (red, blue, green, yellow, purple, orange, white) and a different genre (mystery, romance, sci-fi, biography, fantasy, history, poetry). Extract these facts:
- The red book is somewhere to the left of the green book
- The mystery book is at one end of the shelf
- The biography is exactly four books away from the fantasy book
- The yellow book is not adjacent to the purple book
- The green book is three books to the right of the blue book

=== Stage 2: Relational Constraint Inference ===
Apply these additional constraints:
- The romance book is between the mystery and the sci-fi book
- The white book is at an odd-numbered position
- The blue book and the poetry book are not adjacent
- The red book is at position 2
- The green book is not at position 7

=== Stage 3: Constraint Propagation and Elimination ===
Eliminate impossible book-position and genre-color assignments. Cross-reference to narrow down.

=== Stage 4: Complete Assignment ===
Output each position's book color and genre. Verify all constraints.
